title: Everyday routine: never partying, reading at her mother's
summary: She went home to sleep, was never late to work, and spent days at her mother's reading.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: (Inaudible) So -- but your everyday life -- you worked late, singing here in New York in the twenties.
You'd work in the cabarets or theaters, where ever, late. And then I guess most show business people
went and partied the rest of the night. Or a lot of people.
Well, I didn't. I never did.
No, I never did. I'd go home, get my sleep, and the time come to go to work, I've never been late on a job in my life. I've been at the hospital 20 years, and I've never been late once.
You had no -- I mean, what did you do then, during the day?
Stay there with my mother, maybe trying to sit in my room and read. I'd read. Used to read a lot.
